abilities.name: sturdy
abilities.effect: Prevents being KOed from full HP, leaving 1 HP instead.  Protects against the one-hit KO moves regardless of HP.

abilities.name: sand-veil
abilities.effect: Increases evasion to 1.25× during a sandstorm.  Protects against sandstorm damage.

kanto.flavorText: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without taking damage.

original-johto.flavorText: Its rock-like body is so durable, even high-powered dynamite blasts fail to scratch its rugged hide.

hoenn.flavorText: It is said to live in volcanic craters on mountain peaks. Once a year, it sheds its hide and grows larger. The shed hide crumbles and returns to the soil.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It tumbles down mountains, leaving grooves from peak to base. Stay clear of these grooves.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Even dynamite can’t harm its hard, boulderlike body. It sheds its hide just once a year.

updated-johto.flavorText: It is capable of blowing itself up. It uses this explosive force to jump from mountain to mountain.

original-unova.flavorText: Even dynamite can’t harm its hard, boulderlike body. It sheds its hide just once a year.

updated-unova.flavorText: Even dynamite can’t harm its hard, boulder-like body. It sheds its hide just once a year.

kalos.flavorText: Even dynamite can’t harm its hard, boulder-like body. It sheds its hide just once a year.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Golem is known for rolling down from mountains. To prevent them from rolling into the homes of people downhill, grooves have been dug into the sides of mountains to serve as guideways for diverting this Pokémon’s course.

original-alola.flavorText: Once a year, this Pokémon molts, and its shed shell returns to the soil. This process creates enriched soil, so farmers collect the shells.

updated-alola.flavorText: It detonates its own body. The power from that explosion can propel it up steep mountain paths with amazing speed.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Once it sheds its skin, its body turns tender and whitish. Its hide hardens when it’s exposed to air.

pla.flavorText: The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.
